en.headline: Weekend brings stronger winds, showers and thunderstorms
en.dek: The Observatory expects a broader low-pressure area over the South China Sea to combine with the northeast monsoon, producing windier conditions and more showers from Saturday afternoon into Sunday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China through the middle of next week. A broad area of low pressure is expected to develop gradually over the central South China Sea during the weekend and move towards the seas south of Hainan Island.

Under the combined influence of the monsoon and the low-pressure system, the coast of Guangdong will become windier with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms. Swells are also expected. On Saturday, winds will be east to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and up to force 7 on high ground later, with mainly cloudy skies, a few showers and more showers plus thunderstorms in some areas later. Sunday is forecast to be cloudy with a few showers, more showers and squally thunderstorms in places, and similar wind strengths at first.

Temperatures are expected to range from about 25 to 30 degrees Celsius on Saturday and 25 to 28 degrees on Sunday. The Observatory advised the public to take note of the changing conditions, especially those planning outdoor or marine activities over the weekend.

zh.headline: 周末風勢較大 部分地區有驟雨及雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台預料南海中部低壓區與東北季候風共同影響，周六下午起至周日廣東沿岸風勢較大，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，並有湧浪。
body: 香港天文台表示，東北季候風會持續影響華南，至下周中期。預料周末期間南海中部會有一個廣闊的低壓區逐漸發展，並移向海南島以南海域。
受東北季候風與該低壓系統共同影響，廣東沿岸風勢較大，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，並有湧浪。周六吹東至東北風4至5級，離岸間中6級，稍後高地達7級，大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，稍後部分地區驟雨較多及有雷暴。周日多雲，有幾陣驟雨，部分地區驟雨較多及有狂風雷暴，初時風力相若。
氣溫方面，周六約25至30度，周日約25至28度。天文台呼籲市民留意天氣變化，尤其計劃周末進行戶外或海上活動的人士。
